# API index (generated by tools/gen_docs.php)

Signatures of every core helper. Read the function body in the named file before relying on edge-case behaviour.

## includes/auth.php

- `session_boot(): void`
- `session_rotate(): void` - Move the session data to a new session id (after sign-in or a password change) so an old id cannot be reused. session_regenerate_id(true) deletes the old session at once. A request that was already on its way with the old cookie (a background refresh of the badges, a double click) then starts an empty session and its Set-Cookie replaces the new cookie, which signs the person out. So the old id is kept for a few seconds as a bare pointer to the new one, holding no data.
- `session_follow_rotation(): void` - A request that arrives with a session id that was rotated moments ago continues in the new session (see session_rotate). */
- `current_user(bool $reload = false): ?array` - Signed-in user (users + profile + avatar + tier) or null. Cached per request. */
- `is_logged_in(): bool`
- `auth_id(): int`
- `is_admin_user(): bool`
- `home_for_role(string $role): string`
- `admin_ip_allowed(): bool`
- `attempt_login(string $email, string $password): array` - Check credentials. Does NOT start the session unless $finish is true. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'error'=>string, 'user_id'=>int, 'needs_2fa'=>bool]
- `login_user(int $userId, bool $remember = false): void`
- `logout_user(bool $clearCookie = true): void`
- `remember_issue(int $userId): void`
- `remember_login_from_cookie(): void`
- `remember_refresh(): void` - Keep an active member signed in: while they keep using the site, the "stay signed in" token is pushed further out instead of quietly running out one day. Checked at most once a day per session, and only once the token is past half its life, so it costs almost nothing.
- `remember_forget_current(): void`
- `token_create(int $userId, string $type, int $ttlMinutes = 60): string` - Returns "selector.validator" to put in an emailed link. */
- `token_peek(string $type, string $token): ?int` - Look at a token without using it. Returns the user id or null. */
- `token_consume(string $type, string $token): ?int` - Use a token (single use). Returns the user id or null. */
- `require_login(): array` - Require a signed-in user (any role). Redirects to login, or 401 for API calls. */
- `require_role(string $role): array` - Require one role; users of another role are sent to their own home. */
- `require_user(): array`
- `require_host(): array`
- `require_member(): array` - Explorer or host (anyone who is not an admin). */
- `require_admin(string $module = '', string $level = 'view'): array` - Admin guard with optional module permission. Levels: none < view < edit < full.
- `admin_permissions(): array`
- `admin_can(string $module, string $level = 'view'): bool`
- `create_account(array $d): int` - Create an account with its profile rows. Input is trusted (validate first). Keys: email, password, role (user|host), display_name, date_of_birth, gender, interested_in, phone, county_id, town_name Returns the new user id.
- `set_user_location_from_location(int $userId, int $locationId, ?string $townName = null): void` - Store a user's location from a county/town row (no GPS). */
- `base32_encode(string $bin): string`
- `base32_decode(string $s): string`
- `totp_generate_secret(): string`
- `totp_code(string $secret, ?int $timeSlice = null): string`
- `totp_verify(string $secret, string $code, int $window = 1): bool`
- `totp_uri(string $secret, string $email): string`

## includes/bootstrap.php

- `apply_timezone(): void`
- `cache_code_guard(): void` - Saved pages, menus and counters from the previous release can have a different shape from what the new code expects, which showed up as empty or half-drawn admin sections right after an update. When the code changes, start with a clean cache.

## includes/db.php

- `db(): PDO`
- `db_connect_check(): bool`
- `db_expand(string $sql, array $params): array` - Rewrite a statement so every named parameter occurrence is unique and array values are expanded. Quoted strings and backtick identifiers are skipped. @return array [string $sql, array $params]
- `q(string $sql, array $params = []): PDOStatement`
- `row(string $sql, array $params = []): ?array` - First row or null. */
- `rows(string $sql, array $params = []): array` - All rows. */
- `val(string $sql, array $params = [], $default = null)` - First column of first row, or $default. */
- `col(string $sql, array $params = []): array` - First column of every row as a flat list. */
- `pairs(string $sql, array $params = []): array` - Rows keyed by the first column (value = remaining columns or the second column when only two). */
- `db_ident(string $name): string`
- `insert(string $table, array $data): int` - INSERT a row from an associative array. Returns the new auto-increment id (0 when none). */
- `update(string $table, array $data, array $where): int` - UPDATE rows matching an equality $where array. Returns the number of rows changed. */
- `delete_rows(string $table, array $where): int`
- `db_transaction(callable $fn)` - Run $fn inside a transaction; rolls back and rethrows on failure. */
- `sql_split(string $sql): array` - Split an SQL script into statements, respecting quotes and comments. Used by the installer and updater.

- `subscription_switch_credit(int $userId, int $planId, string $period): array` - What happens to the days left on a different paid plan when a member buys $planId for $period. Their value is turned into extra days of the new plan (days left x the old plan's price per day / the new plan's price per day), so switching never throws away time that was paid for. Renewing the same plan needs no conversion (the days are simply added). Prices are today's plan prices; the old plan's price per day uses the period it was bought for. @return array ['days' => extra days of the new plan, 'left' => whole days left on the old plan, 'from' => old plan name]
- `subscription_activate(int $userId, int $planId, string $period = 'monthly', ?int $grantedBy = null, ?int $days = null): string` - Activate (or extend) a subscription. Returns the expiry datetime. */
- `subscription_cancel(int $userId): void`

- `payment_complete(int $paymentId, array $extra = [], ?int $adminId = null): array` - Mark a payment completed and deliver what was bought. Safe to call more than once: fulfilment runs a single time. Returns [bool delivered, string note].
- `payment_fail(int $paymentId, string $status = 'failed', string $reason = ''): void`
- `plans_housekeeping(): array` - Expire subscriptions and clean stale pending payments (called by cron). */

## includes/lib/admin_analytics.php

- `admin_analytics_metrics(): array` - Metric name => [label, how a week or month is combined: sum|avg]. Names shared with cron_analytics_snapshot() keep its meaning. */
- `admin_analytics_range(): array` - Selected range from the query string: ?range=7|30|90|365 or ?from=Y-m-d&to=Y-m-d. @return array from, to, days, preset, prev_from, prev_to, gran (day|week), label
- `admin_analytics_next(string $date): string` - Next calendar day (exclusive upper bound for datetime comparisons). */
- `admin_analytics_live(string $metric, string $from, string $to): array` - Live daily values for one metric between two dates (inclusive). @return array<string,float> date => value (days without activity are missing)
- `admin_analytics_series(string $metric, array $dates): array` - Values for a metric on each of $dates (Y-m-d list): stored totals where they exist, live numbers for the rest. @return float[] in the order of $dates
- `admin_analytics_bucket(array $dates, array $values, string $gran, string $how = 'sum'): array` - Combine daily values into weeks (Monday start) when the range is long. @return array [labels[], values[]]
- `admin_analytics_snapshot(string $date): int` - Store one day of totals in analytics_daily. Returns the number of metrics written (0 for a bad or future date). */
- `admin_analytics_backfill(int $days): int` - Store the last $days complete days (yesterday backwards), one query per metric. Returns how many days were written. */
- `admin_analytics_funnel(string $from, string $to): array` - Funnel for members who registered in the range. A step only counts members who also completed every step before it. @return array list of [key, label, count, pct_of_registered, pct_of_previous]
- `admin_analytics_revenue(string $from, string $to): array` - Money for a range: totals, by type, by plan, by method, and the boost, gift and booking numbers. @return array
- `admin_analytics_geo(string $from, string $to, int $limit = 8): array` - Where active members are: top counties and towns, with how many of them joined in the range. */
- `admin_analytics_people(): array` - Gender and age of active members. */
- `admin_analytics_cohorts(int $weeks = 8): array` - Weekly sign-up cohorts (last $weeks weeks, Monday start): did they come back, are they still around, did they match and message. @return array list of [week_start, size, back, a7, a30, matched, messaged]
- `admin_analytics_bundle(array $rg): array` - Everything the analytics page and its exports need for one range, cached for a minute. */

- `ac_reserved_slugs(): array` - Slugs that belong to core routes and cannot be used by CMS pages. */
- `ac_excerpt(string $html, int $len = 180): string` - Plain-text opening of rich content, with a space where block tags end. */

Returns ['path'=>new-or-kept path|null, 'error'=>string, 'changed'=>bool, 'old'=>path to delete after the row is saved]. A "remove_<field>" checkbox clears the image. Call ac_image_commit() once the database row is written.

Pass $failed when the save did not happen: a file stored just now is removed again, a picked library file is left alone.

## includes/lib/admin_tools.php

- `admin_tools_clear_cache(): int` - Empty storage/cache and reset PHP's opcode cache. The "last ran" markers of scheduled jobs are kept, otherwise every daily and weekly job (including the weekly e-mail digest) would run again at the next cron tick. @return int number of cache files removed
- `admin_tools_regenerate_theme(): int` - Rebuild the generated theme CSS from the current settings. Returns its size in bytes. */
- `admin_tools_demo_domain(): string`
- `admin_tools_demo_counts(): array` - Counts of demo members. Admin accounts are never counted or removed, even when they use the demo e-mail domain. */
- `admin_tools_demo_remove(): int` - Delete demo members and their photos, never an admin. Returns how many members were removed. */
- `admin_tools_table_sizes(): array` - @return array list of ['name','rows','bytes'] largest first */
- `admin_tools_backup_stream(bool $withData): void` - Stream a complete .sql dump (structure and, optionally, data) to the browser. Pure PDO, no mysqldump. Rows are written in extended INSERT statements and flushed as they are read, so memory stays flat on large tables.
- `admin_tools_blur_batch(int $after, int $batch): array` - Rebuild the blurred copy (file and tiny inline preview) of a batch of member photos. $after is the id of the last photo done so far (0 to start). Returns total, processed (including skipped), errors, the new cursor and done.
- `admin_tools_orphan_scan(int $minAgeSeconds = 86400): array` - Compare files in /uploads with every path the database mentions. Nothing is deleted. @return array scanned_at, files, bytes, referenced, orphans[ [path, bytes, mtime] ], orphan_count, orphan_bytes, recent, missing[], missing_count, columns, truncated
- `admin_tools_run_cron(bool $force): array` - Run the scheduled jobs now, using the same lock as cron/run.php so two runs never overlap. @return array ['ran' => bool, 'message' => string, 'log' => array]
- `admin_tools_send_test_mail(string $to): array` - Send a test message through the configured mail driver. @return array ['ok' => bool, 'driver' => string, 'message' => string] */
- `admin_tools_php_info(): array` - A short, safe subset of PHP and server settings. @return array section => list of [label, value, status ok|warn|bad|''] */
- `admin_tools_cron_info(): array` - Everything an admin needs to set up the cron job: the ready-to-paste commands for this server, and what each job does. @return array ['php' => string, 'root' => string, 'url' => string, 'key_set' => bool, 'suggest_key' => string, 'commands' => list<array>, 'jobs' => list<array>]
- `admin_db_expected(): array`
- `admin_db_check(): array` - What is missing from this database. Returns ['tables' => [name], 'columns' => [table => [column]], 'migrations' => [done, total], 'upgrade_error' => string].
- `admin_db_problem_count(array $c): int`
- `admin_db_repair(): array` - Apply pending upgrades, then create missing tables and add missing columns. Returns report lines and any errors. */

## includes/lib/agents.php

- `agent_tiers(): array` - Tiers, strongest first: key => [label, weight, icon]. The weight decides the order when a block shows several. */
- `agent_sorts(): array` - Ways a showcase block can order agents of the same tier. */
- `agents_public_ok(): bool` - Are agents allowed on public pages at all (Hosts on, and the directory not closed to this visitor)? An 18+ prompt still counts as open. */
- `agents_candidates(int $categoryId = 0, int $limit = 600, int $onlyId = 0): array` - Tier facts for approved, active agents, optionally limited to one category. @return array<int, array> id => [vip, featured, premium, paid, boosted (bool), pin (int), rating, reviews, approved (ts), active (ts), verified (bool)]
- `agent_top_tier(array $flags): ?array` - The strongest tier of one agent (from agents_candidates()), as [key, label, icon], or null for an agent in no tier. */
- `agents_block_options(array $c): array` - Read a showcase block's saved content into the settings the engine uses (clamped, with defaults). Keys: count, tiers (list of keys), fill, sort, category, pinned (bool).
- `agents_rank(array $o, string $seed = ''): array` - Ranked agent ids for a block: [id => weight]. Strongest first. An agent pinned by an admin always qualifies and comes first. With no tier ticked every agent qualifies equally. When $o['fill'] is on, agents outside the ticked tiers follow the ones inside.
- `landing_agents(array $c, string $seed = ''): array` - The agents a showcase block shows, as decorated member rows (hosts_decorate) with ['tier' => [key,label,icon]|null] added. Cached per block for two minutes; the visitor's own distance and blocks are applied after the cache.
- `agent_join_place(): string` - Where the round "Become an agent" button is shown: menu, strip, both or off. */
- `agent_join_cta(?array $viewer = null): ?array` - The round "Become an agent" button for the menus, or null when it does not belong there. Hidden from people who are already agents or admins, and while Host accounts are switched off.
- `story_settings(): array` - Story strip settings, clamped. Keys: on, pages (list), count, tiers (list), fill, join, ads, viewer, seconds, drift, promo. Set in Admin > Agent showcase > Stories.
- `landing_story_agents(?int $limit = null): array` - Agents for the round story strip: the ticked tiers first (VIP, then featured ...), then, when "fill" is on, everyone else. */
- `story_adverts(string $page, int $limit = 6): array` - Active sponsored story adverts for a page (Admin > Adverts, format "Story"). Honours the site-wide adverts switch and ad-free plans. */
- `story_items(string $page = 'landing'): array` - Everything the story strip and viewer need, in display order: a "Become an agent" bubble, VIP/featured agents, sponsored promotions, then the other agents. Each item: kind (join|agent|ad), key (for "seen" memory), label, img, blur, tier, href, and 'v' (what the viewer shows).
- `agent_tier_of(int $hostId): ?array` - The strongest tier of one agent as [key, label, icon], or null (not approved, or in no tier). */
- `agents_similar(int $hostId, int $categoryId, int $limit = 8): array` - Agents to suggest under a profile: the same category first, then anyone else, never the agent being viewed. @return array decorated member rows (see landing_agents)
- `agent_bio(array $m, ?string $about = null): string` - "Meet Amina from Westlands. Her own text." from the admin's template. $m is a decorated member row or any array with name/town/about. */
- `agent_card_contacts(int $hostId): array` - Contact buttons a viewer may see for one agent: [] when none. Items are [field => ['label','value']]. */

## includes/lib/choices.php

- `choice_defaults(): array` - Built-in cards. The admin's saved values (setting choice_cards, JSON keyed by mode) are laid over these. */
- `choice_valid(string $mode): bool` - The modes a choice can be: the four cards plus "all" (skipped, show everything). */
- `choice_cards_all(bool $fresh = false): array` - Saved admin values for every card (also the disabled ones), in admin order. */
- `choice_cards(string $where = 'any'): array` - Cards that can be chosen right now: enabled by the admin and backed by a module that is switched on. $where narrows it to one place: 'picker' for the opening question, 'switch' for the menu and the chip on Discover. So a card such as Elite can be left out of the question people are asked first and still be one tap away in the menu. 'any' is every card that is on somewhere.
- `choice_cards_reset(): void` - Forget the cards held for this request (after the admin saves). */
- `choice_current(): string` - The current visitor's choice: '' (never chose), 'all' (skipped) or a card key that is still available. */
- `choice_effective(): string` - What the site arranges itself around for this visitor: their own choice, or (when they have not chosen) the experience the admin set as the default, which is Dating. '' only when there is no default to fall back on (setting choice_default is "Everything", or the default card is switched off). The picker still asks; this is what they see until they answer.
- `choice_save(string $mode): bool` - Save a choice on this device and, for a signed-in member, on their profile. Returns false for an unknown choice. */
- `choice_is_bot(): bool` - Search engines, link previews and uptime checks never see the picker. */
- `choice_should_open(): bool` - Should the picker open by itself on this page view? */
- `choice_active_card(): ?array` - The card for the current choice, or null for "never chose" and "everything". */
- `choice_landing_sections(array $sections): array` - Landing blocks for the current choice: hidden ones removed, the "show first" ones moved to the top in the admin's order. */
- `choice_hero(): array` - Hero overrides for the current choice: ['h' => heading, 's' => line, 'cta' => button text, 'url' => button link] (empty = keep the site's). */
- `choice_cards_save(array $in): array` - Admin: validate and store the cards posted by the Visitor choices editor. Returns [ok, error]. */
- `choice_stats(): array` - How many members chose each option (for the admin page). */
- `choice_art(string $accent): string` - Built-in picture for a card, drawn as inline SVG so it is sharp on every screen and costs no download. */

A view only replaces it once the member has chosen one themselves: a saved preference counts only when view_set_at is filled in, and the device cookie is the fallback.

Returns ['search' => filters, 'values' => form values, 'chips' => [[key,label]], 'count' => active extra filters, 'locked' => [keys ignored], 'prefs' => saved preferences, 'recycle' => bring back profiles the member passed on once everyone else has been seen].

Personalised through the match scores. $exclude are ids the client already holds. Returns ['rows' => normalised, 'total' => int].
- `explorer_allowance(int $userId): array` - Remaining daily allowances for the viewer (-1 = unlimited) and the plan flags the UI needs. */
- `explorer_daily_picks(int $userId): array` - Today's picks as normalised members (generated on first call each day). [] when the feature is off. */

- `explorer_interests_of(int $userId, array $viewerInterestIds): array` - "5 shared interests" etc: interests of a member with the viewer's shared ones flagged. */
- `explorer_profile_details(array $m): array` - Human readable detail rows for a profile: [[icon,label,value], ...] */
- `explorer_contact_href(string $field, string $value): string` - Contact link for a visible value. */
- `explorer_contact_rules(): array` - Who can see each contact field, as plain sentences for the member's own settings. */
- `explorer_notification_keys(): array` - Notification switches members can set: column => [group, title, hint, default]. */
- `explorer_heal_privacy(int $userId): void` - Make a plan-gated setting honest: incognito only stays on while the plan allows it. */
- `explorer_is_incognito(array $user): bool` - Is this member browsing in incognito right now (setting on AND plan allows it)? */
- `explorer_reports_extended(): bool` - Does the reports table have the Explorer columns (database/schema/10_explorer.sql)? */
- `explorer_cookie(string $name, string $value): void` - Set a cookie that lives for a year. */

- `explorer_str(array $b, string $key, int $max = 255): string`
- `explorer_fail(array $r): void` - Send a failure array from explorer_* actions as JSON. */

- `explorer_members_by_ids(array $ids): array` - Normalised members for a list of ids, in that order (anyone hidden by the usual rules is left out). */

## includes/lib/hosts.php

- `hosts_text_variants(string $text): array` - Lower-cased text plus a version with common character swaps undone (s3x, $ex), for word checks. */
- `hosts_term_list(string $settingKey): array`
- `hosts_term_match(string $text, array $terms): ?string`
- `hosts_text_violation(string $text): ?string` - Check host- or client-written text against the general banned words (Safety settings) and the Hosts list (host_banned_terms). Returns the matched word, or null when the text is fine.
- `hosts_contact_violation(string $text): ?string` - Public Host text (profile, packages, reviews, replies) must not carry contact details or ways to take a booking off the platform. Returns what was found (email, link, phone number, handle, app) or null.
- `hosts_phone_local(string $phone): string` - A stored phone number (2547...) as people type it: "0712 345 678". Other formats come back unchanged. */
- `hosts_contact_message(string $field = 'This text'): string` - The standard refusal message for text that carries contact details. */
- `hosts_private_place_violation(string $text): ?string` - A meeting place must be public. Returns the matched private-place word or null. */
- `hosts_violation_message(string $field = 'This text'): string` - The standard refusal message for text that breaks the rules. */
- `hosts_rules_lines(): array` - Rules text as a list of ['type' => 'p'|'li', 'text' => string] for rendering. */
- `hosts_cancellation_lines(): array` - Cancellation policy as plain sentences, built from the settings. */
- `hosts_enabled(): bool`
- `hosts_booking_enabled(): bool`
- `hosts_user_has_bookings(int $uid): bool` - Has this member (as Host or as client) any booking on record? Keeps their booking pages open after bookings are switched off. */
- `hosts_user_has_payouts(int $uid): bool` - Has this Host any payout on record? Keeps Earnings and Payouts in their menu after bookings are switched off. */
- `hosts_bookings_guard(bool $keepIfAny = true): void` - Stop a booking page when the admin has switched bookings off. People who already have bookings can still open the pages that show them ($keepIfAny), so nothing paid is ever hidden.
- `hosts_contact_mode(): string` - The rule in force. "after_booking" needs bookings, so it becomes "members" while bookings are off. */
- `hosts_contact_policy_text(): string` - One sentence for Hosts: who can see the contact details they add. */
- `hosts_contact_access(?array $viewer, int $hostId): array` - May this viewer see the Host's contact details? Returns ['allowed' => bool, 'reason' => ''|'login'|'upgrade'|'booking'|'hidden'|'rules']. 'rules' means the admin chose the Privacy contact table: member_contacts() decides field by field.
- `hosts_contacts_for(int $hostId, ?array $viewer = null): array` - What the contact card on a Host's profile should show for the current viewer. @return array ['state' => 'visible'|'login'|'upgrade'|'booking'|'hidden'|'none', 'items' => [field => ['label','value']], 'note' => string]
- `hosts_categories(): array` - Active categories with a computed url slug: [id => row]. */
- `hosts_category_by_slug(string $slug): ?array`
- `hosts_services_catalog(): array` - Active service tags the admin manages: [id => row]. */
- `hosts_ids($csv): array` - "1,2,3" or array to a clean list of positive ints. */
- `hosts_locations_by_ids(array $ids): array` - Names of locations by id: [id => ['id','name','type','parent_id','county_name']] in the order given. */
- `hosts_ext(int $userId): array` - The host's extension row (defaults when none exists yet). */
- `hosts_ext_save(int $userId, array $data): void` - Update extension fields (creates the row if needed). Only known columns are written. */
- `hosts_services_grouped(): array` - Services grouped for the picker: [group name => [id => row]], groups in catalogue order. */
- `hosts_prices_allowed($showPricesFlag): bool` - May this Host's prices be shown, given the admin switch and the Host's own choice (ext.show_prices)? */
- `hosts_listing_required(): bool` - Are Hosts asked to pay to be listed? */
- `hosts_listing_sql(string $alias = 'hp'): string` - SQL fragment (starts with AND) that keeps unpaid Hosts out of public lists. Empty when no fee is charged. $alias is the host_profiles alias. */
- `hosts_listing_active(array $ext): bool` - Is this Host's listing paid up (or free of charge)? $ext is a host_profile_ext row or merged profile. */
- `hosts_listing_plans(): array` - Listing options an admin has priced: [period => ['label','days','price']]. A price of 0 switches that period off. */
- `hosts_listing_extend(int $hostId, int $days, string $period = 'custom'): string` - Add days to a Host's listing (from today, or from the current end if it is still running). Returns the new end as 'Y-m-d H:i:s'. */
- `hosts_profile(int $userId): ?array` - Host profile row merged with the extension row, or null when the user has no host profile. */
- `hosts_is_public(array $hp): bool` - Can the public see this host (approved, active account, not paused out of the directory)? */
- `hosts_offerings(int $hostId, bool $activeOnly = true): array` - Package rows for a host. */
- `hosts_offering(int $id, int $hostId): ?array`
- `hosts_from_rate(array $hp, ?array $offerings = null): ?float` - Lowest hourly-equivalent price a host offers: min of the hourly rate and each package. Null when nothing is priced. */
- `hosts_offerings_save(int $hostId, array $rows, bool $replaceAll = true): array` - Validate and save a host's packages. $rows: list of ['id'?, 'service_id'?, 'name', 'description', 'duration_hours', 'price']. Rows with an empty name are skipped. Returns ['ok' => bool, 'errors' => [], 'saved' => int].
- `hosts_time_to_min($t): ?int` - "HH:MM" (or "24:00") to minutes from midnight, or null when invalid. */
- `hosts_min_to_time(int $m): string` - Minutes to "HH:MM". 1440 gives "24:00". */
- `hosts_time_label(int $m): string` - 24h minutes to a friendly 12h label: "6:30 pm". */
- `hosts_weekly_normalize($input): array` - Clean a weekly availability array (the JSON format in the contract): keys mon..sun, each a list of ["HH:MM","HH:MM"]. A window whose end is not later than its start runs past midnight (["20:00","02:00"]). Overlapping windows are merged, at most 4 per day are kept. Unknown or malformed entries are dropped.
- `hosts_weekly(array $hp): array` - The weekly schedule stored on a host profile, normalised (all days present). */
- `hosts_weekly_default(): array` - Starting schedule for a new host: every day 10:00 to 20:00. */
- `hosts_day_diff(string $a, string $b): int` - Whole days from date $a to date $b (b - a), independent of time zones. */
- `hosts_valid_date(string $d): bool`
- `hosts_slot_options(): array` - Rules for slot computation from the settings. */
- `hosts_slots_compute(array $weekly, string $date, float $hours, array $blocked, array $bookings, array $o = []): array` - Pure slot calculator (no database): which start times on $date can fit a booking of $hours? @param array $weekly normalised weekly schedule (hosts_weekly_normalize) @param string $date Y-m-d, the day the booking starts @param float $hours booking length @param array $blocked list of blocked Y-m-d dates @param array $bookings list of ['date' => Y-m-d, 'start' => 'HH:MM[:SS]', 'hours' => float] that hold a slot @param array $o now (timestamp), tz, min_notice_hours, max_advance_days, step (minutes), buffer (minutes) @return array list of ['start' => 'HH:MM', 'end' => 'HH:MM', 'next_day' => bool, 'label' => '6:00 pm', 'ts' => int]
- `hosts_slot_bookings(int $hostId, string $from, string $to, $exclude = 0): array` - Bookings that hold a slot for a host between two dates (inclusive). Unpaid bookings count while their payment hold lasts. */
- `hosts_blocked_dates(int $hostId, string $from, string $to): array`
- `hosts_free_slots(int $hostId, string $date, float $hours, $excludeBookingId = 0, array $override = []): array` - Free start times for one host on one date. $excludeBookingId (an id or a list of ids) is ignored, for re-checks. */
- `hosts_available_days(int $hostId, float $hours, ?string $from = null, int $days = 30, array $hp = []): array` - How many start times each day offers, for $days days starting at $from: [Y-m-d => count]. One database round trip per table, not one per day.
- `hosts_ids_available_on(array $hostMinHours, string $date): array` - Which of these hosts have at least one free slot on $date? Used by the directory's date filter. Returns host ids. */
- `hosts_price_for_hours(array $hp, float $hours): float` - Price for a custom length: the hourly rate, with the half-day (4 h) and full-day (8 h) rates applied when they are cheaper. Returns 0 when the host has no hourly rate.
- `hosts_quote(array $hp, ?array $offering, float $hours, bool $travel = false, array $o = []): array` - Price breakdown for a booking, from the host's rates and the platform settings (never from the client). @param array $hp host profile (hosts_profile) @param array|null $offering a package row, or null for custom hours @param float $hours length (ignored when a package is given: the package length is used) @param bool $travel add the host's travel fee @param array $o optional overrides for tests: deposit_pct, commission_pct @return array hours, base, travel_fee, total, deposit_pct, deposit, balance, commission_pct, commission, host_earning
- `hosts_hours_label(float $hours): string` - "2 hours", "1.5 hours", "30 minutes". */
- `hosts_booking_start_ts(array $b): int` - Start timestamp of a booking row. */
- `hosts_booking_end_ts(array $b): int`
- `hosts_booking_get(int $id): ?array` - A booking with its extension columns, or null. */
- `hosts_event(int $bookingId, string $event, ?array $actor = null, string $note = ''): void` - Add a line to a booking's timeline. $actor: ['id' => int, 'role' => string] or null for the system. */
- `hosts_booking_parties(array $b): array` - Display names for both sides of a booking: ['host' => ['id','name','email'], 'client' => [...]]. */
- `hosts_booking_summary(array $b, bool $forHost = false): array` - Everything a booking e-mail needs as label => value. */
- `hosts_booking_notify(array $b, int $toUserId, string $type, string $title, string $body, string $url, string $mailIntro = '', string $mailLabel = 'View booking', ?int $senderId = null): void` - In-app notification plus a booking e-mail. Hosts can switch the e-mail off in their settings. $type: 'booking' for new requests, 'booking_update' for changes, 'review' for reviews.
- `hosts_notify_admins(string $title, string $body, string $url, string $type = 'system'): void` - Tell every active admin about something that needs a decision (application, refund). */
- `hosts_booking_create(array $client, int $hostId, array $in): array` - Create a booking and its deposit payment. $in: offering_id (0 = custom hours), hours, date (Y-m-d), start (HH:MM), venue, area (location id or 'other'), note, accept (terms ticked). Everything is validated here; the slot is re-checked while the host's profile row is locked, so two clients can never take the same time. @return array ['ok' => bool, 'error' => string, 'errors' => [field => message], 'booking_id' => int, 'payment_id' => int]
- `booking_payment_completed(array $payment, array $meta): void` - Called by payment_complete() (includes/plans.php) when a booking deposit is paid. Moves the booking to "pending" (host must accept) or "confirmed" (instant booking), tells both people. Idempotent: a second call for the same payment does nothing.
- `hosts_booking_repay(int $bookingId, int $clientId): array` - Get a payment id the client can use to pay the deposit for an unpaid booking (re-using the open payment when there is one). Extends the hold when the time is still free. @return array ['ok', 'error', 'payment_id']
- `hosts_booking_status_label(string $s): string`
- `hosts_booking_badge(string $s): string` - Badge class (from the design system) for a booking status. */
- `hosts_refund_quote(array $b, string $by = 'client', ?int $now = null): array` - What the client would get back if the booking were cancelled now. $by: client | host | admin | system. Returns ['pct' => float, 'amount' => float, 'hours' => float, 'label' => string].
- `hosts_refund_record(array $b, float $amount, float $pct, string $why): void` - Record that money is owed back to the client. The refund itself is paid by an admin (see payments.admin_notes and host_booking_ext.refund_status). */
- `hosts_settle(array $b, float $base, bool $completed): void` - Settle a finished booking: fix the commission on what the platform actually keeps and record what is owed to the host. $base is the money the commission applies to: the full price for a completed booking, the kept deposit for a no-show or late cancellation.
- `hosts_booking_transition(int $id, string $to, array $actor, array $opts = []): array` - Move a booking to a new status. The one place status changes happen. @param int $id booking id @param string $to confirmed | declined | cancelled | completed | no_show @param array $actor ['id' => int, 'role' => 'user'|'host'|'admin'|'system'] @param array $opts reason (text, max 255) @return array ['ok' => bool, 'error' => string, 'status' => string, 'message' => string, 'refund' => ['pct','amount','label']|null]
- `hosts_housekeeping(): array` - Cron job: release unpaid slots, decline unanswered requests, complete finished bookings, send reminders. Safe to run every few minutes. @return array counts
- `hosts_ledger(int $hostId): array` - Money the platform owes a host, booking by booking, with a status for each line: held (inside the payout hold), available, requested (in a payout request) or paid. Payouts are matched to the oldest earnings first. @return array ['rows' => [...], 'balance' => [...]]
- `hosts_balance(int $hostId): array` - Balance summary (see hosts_ledger). Keys: available, held, requested, paid_out, upcoming, earned_total, earned_month, ... */
- `hosts_monthly_earnings(int $hostId, int $months = 12): array` - Earnings per month for the last $months months, oldest first: [['month' => '2026-10', 'label' => 'Oct', 'earning' => float, 'bookings' => int], ...]. */
- `hosts_payout_request(int $hostId, float $amount): array` - Ask for a payout. Checks the minimum, the available balance and payout details inside a transaction. @return array ['ok', 'error', 'id'] */
- `hosts_rating_recalc(int $hostId): void` - Recompute rating_avg and review_count on host_profiles from approved reviews. Call after approving or removing a review. */
- `hosts_review_summary(int $hostId): array` - Average, count and 5..1 star distribution of approved reviews: ['avg' => float, 'count' => int, 'dist' => [5 => n, ...]]. */
- `hosts_reviews(int $hostId, int $limit = 6, int $offset = 0, bool $approvedOnly = true): array` - Reviews of a host with the reviewer's display name (first name only, or "Verified client" when anonymous). */
- `hosts_review_check(array $b, int $clientId): array` - Can this client review this booking? Returns ['ok' => bool, 'error' => string]. */
- `hosts_review_create(int $bookingId, int $clientId, int $rating, string $text, bool $anonymous = true): array` - Save a client's review of a completed booking. @return array ['ok', 'error', 'status'] */
- `hosts_review_decide(int $reviewId, string $decision): array` - Admin decision on a client's review: 'approve' publishes it, 'reject' hides it (an approved review can also be taken down). Keeps the host's rating and review count in step and tells the host when a review goes live. @return array ['ok', 'error', 'status', 'host_id']
- `hosts_review_reply(int $reviewId, int $hostId, string $reply): array` - Host answers a review (once, editable). @return array ['ok', 'error'] */
- `hosts_response_stats(int $hostId): array` - Share of requests the host answered (accepted or declined) and the average time to answer. Null values when there are too few requests. */
- `hosts_completeness(int $hostId): array` - How far a host is from a complete application. @return array ['items' => [...], 'pct' => int, 'complete' => bool, 'photos' => int, 'min_photos' => int] */
- `hosts_submit_application(int $hostId): array` - Submit the application for review (or publish straight away when approval is switched off). Marks onboarding as finished. @return array ['ok' => bool, 'error' => string, 'status' => string, 'missing' => [labels]]
- `hosts_set_approval(int $hostId, string $status, string $note = '', ?int $adminId = null, ?bool $idVerified = null): bool` - Change a Host's approval state (for the admin pages). Tells the host by notification and e-mail. $status: approved | rejected | suspended | pending | draft. $idVerified: null = set it when approving and an ID file exists.
- `hosts_private_dir(): string`
- `hosts_store_private_image(array $file, int $userId, string $kind): array` - Store an ID or selfie image privately: validated, re-encoded as JPEG (EXIF removed) under storage/private/host_id/{userId}/. The folder is never web-served. @return array ['ok' => bool, 'error' => string, 'path' => relative path inside storage/private]
- `hosts_id_file_path(int $hostUserId, string $kind = 'id'): ?string` - Absolute path of a host's private verification file, for admins only. $kind: 'id' (the ID document) or 'selfie'. Returns null for anyone who is not an admin with access to Hosts, or when there is no file. Admin pages stream it with readfile() after sending the right Content-Type, or call hosts_id_file_send().
- `hosts_id_file_send(int $hostUserId, string $kind = 'id'): void` - Send a host's private ID or selfie image to an admin (404 for everyone else). Does not return. */
- `hosts_save_basics(int $hostId, array $in): array`
- `hosts_save_services_contact(int $hostId, array $in): array` - The contact way of saving services: what the Host offers, an optional price beside each one, and the short line that sits above their contact buttons. Rates, packages and travel belong to the booking way and are left exactly as they are, so switching back restores them.
- `hosts_save_services(int $hostId, array $in): array`
- `hosts_save_area(int $hostId, array $in): array`
- `hosts_save_payout(int $hostId, array $in): array`
- `hosts_save_verification(int $hostId, array $in): array` - Save the ID document and selfie from $_FILES (id_file, selfie_file). Existing files are kept when none is uploaded. */
- `hosts_photos_upload(int $hostId): array` - Upload photos from $_FILES['photos']. @return array ['added' => int, 'errors' => [string]] */
- `hosts_save_visibility(int $hostId, array $in): array` - Profile visibility switches and public contact details (user_profiles). */
- `hosts_directory_filters(array $src): array` - Clean the directory query string into a filter array (unknown or invalid values are dropped). */
- `hosts_category_counts(): array` - Number of public Hosts per category id (for the category chips). */
- `hosts_directory(array $f, int $page = 1, int $perPage = 12): array` - The Hosts directory. Host-specific filters run in SQL; blocks, privacy, photo and distance rules come from members_search(); sorting and paging happen in PHP over at most 800 candidates. @param array $f filters from hosts_directory_filters() @return array ['rows' => decorated members, 'total' => int, 'page' => int, 'pages' => int, 'per_page' => int]
- `hosts_decorate(array $members): array` - Add a 'host' array (name, tagline, category, from_rate, rating, services ...) to normalised member rows. */
- `hosts_featured_list(int $limit): array` - Featured Hosts (admin-featured or boosted), best first, for the row above the directory results. */
- `hosts_view(int $id): ?array` - Everything the public profile page needs, built without the directory's visibility rules (the page decides who may look). Returns null when the user has no host profile.
- `hosts_demo_enrich(int $hostId, int $index = 0): void` - Give a demo Host packages, payout details and a few completed bookings with reviews so the pages look lived in. Called by demo_seed() for every demo Host it creates. Safe to call twice.
- `hosts_directory_gate(): array` - Can the current visitor open the Hosts directory? Admins and Hosts always can; everyone else follows Settings (hosts_directory_access) and, for visitors, the 18+ confirmation. Returns [bool allowed, string reason: ok|disabled|login|upgrade|age].
- `hosts_profile_gate(int $hostId): array` - Same as the directory gate, but a client who already has a booking with this Host may always open their page. */
- `hosts_can_view(?array $hp): bool` - Who may look at a Host's page: the public (when approved and visible), the Host themself and admins. */
- `hosts_report(int $reporterId, string $type, int $targetId, string $reason, string $details): array` - Report a Host or one of your bookings. Same table and notification as /api/report, with reasons written for Hosts. @return array ['ok', 'error', 'message'] */
- `hosts_calendar_months(array $counts, string $from, int $days): array` - Month-by-month availability for the profile and booking pages. @param array $counts [Y-m-d => free start times] from hosts_available_days() @return array list of months: ['label' => 'October 2026', 'ym' => '2026-10', 'weeks' => [[cell|null x7], ...]] cell: ['date', 'day', 'count', 'past' => bool, 'today' => bool, 'in_range' => bool]
- `hosts_min_booking_hours(array $hp, array $offerings): float` - Shortest length (hours) a client can book from this Host: the smaller of the minimum custom length and the shortest package. */
- `hosts_stars(float $rating, string $class = ''): string` - Stars row. $rating 0 to 5, one decimal. */
- `hosts_use_app_layout(): void` - Use the signed-in member shell for pages that serve both visitors and members. */
- `hosts_api_host(int $id): array` - Load a Host for a JSON endpoint: 404 when the viewer may not see them, 403 when the directory is gated for the viewer. */
- `hosts_resolve_hours(array $hp, $offeringId, $hours): array` - Hours for a request: from a package, or the custom length checked against this Host's limits. Returns [offering|null, hours|0]. */
- `hosts_my(): array` - The signed-in Host's profile row (with extension), creating an empty draft when an account has none yet. */
- `hosts_first_open_step(int $hostId): string` - Step key to open first on /host/setup: the first part of the application that is not finished. */

## includes/lib/international.php

- `intl_enabled(): bool`
- `intl_mode(): string`
- `intl_join_required(): bool`
- `intl_access_required(): bool`
- `intl_exempt(int $userId): bool` - True when the member's plan includes International at no charge. */
- `intl_profile(int $userId): ?array`
- `intl_access_until(int $userId): ?string` - When paid access ends: null means no access, 0 means it never ends. */
- `intl_has_access(int $userId): bool` - May this member browse and contact listed members? */
- `intl_profile_live(array $p): bool` - Is this profile row visible to others right now (approved, not paused, and paid when listing is paid)? */
- `intl_is_listed(int $userId): bool`
- `intl_grant_access(int $userId, int $days, string $source = 'purchase'): ?string` - Add days to paid access (0 days = for good). Extends from the current end when still running. */
- `intl_extend_listing(int $userId, int $days): ?string` - Paid listing time. Returns the new end, or null for a listing that never ends. */
- `intl_price_label(string $kind): string` - Text about a price: "KSh 500 for 30 days" or "KSh 500, once". */
- `intl_pricing_summary(): array` - What the pricing is, for the page, in plain words. */
- `intl_csv(string $s): array`
- `intl_normalize_number(string $dial, string $national): ?string` - Phone numbers kept as '+' and digits only. Returns null when it does not look like a real number. */
- `intl_text_has_contact(string $t): bool` - Text that hides phone numbers and links, so people keep contact details inside the private contact field. */
- `intl_save_profile(int $userId, array $in): array` - Save the signed-in member's international profile. $in is the raw form data. Returns ['ok' => bool, 'errors' => [field => message], 'status' => string].
- `intl_require_verified_block(int $userId): bool` - True when only verified members may list and this member is not verified. */
- `intl_member_ids(int $viewerId, array $f = []): array` - Which listed members to show. Filters: country, language, purpose, wants_me (only people open to my country), q. */
- `intl_cards(int $viewerId, array $f, int $limit, int $offset): array` - Cards for the browse page: the usual member data plus the international profile. Returns ['rows' => [...], 'total' => n].
- `intl_stats(): array` - Public numbers for the hero: how many members, in how many countries. Counts only live listings. */
- `intl_contact_visible(int $viewerId, int $ownerId): bool` - Can this member see the other's number? Only when the owner chose to share, and both people have written in the chat.
- `intl_contact_text(array $p): string`
- `intl_message_ok(int $me, int $targetId): bool` - Messaging door: a member with International access may message any live listing. Returns true when that applies. */
- `checkout_intl(string $kind): array` - Start a payment for a listing or for access. $kind is 'join' or 'access'. */
- `intl_hero_arcs(): array` - Decorative arcs and dots for the page hero: fixed city-like points on the globe joined by curved lines. */
- `intl_journey(int $uid): array` - The member's path through International, as three steps with one clear next action. Each step: key, title, text, state (done|current|todo), and optionally action => [label, href|form kind].
- `intl_admin_overview(): array` - Admin overview numbers: queue, money, countries, a short health checklist. */
- `intl_setup_sentence(): string` - One-line summary of what members will see with the chosen setup. */

## includes/lib/landing.php

- `landing_art_defaults(): array` - Built-in pictures for the landing page sections. The admin can replace, remove or pick another for each one. */
- `landing_image(array $c, string $default, string $field = 'image'): string` - Picture URL for a landing section ('' when the admin removed it). A section that has never been saved with a picture field shows the built-in art; a saved empty value means "no picture". $default is the "@art/..." path used when the key is missing from the section's content.
- `landing_image_is_cutout(string $rel): bool` - Does this picture have see-through corners (a cut-out with no background)? Looks at the four corners and the middle of the top edge of PNG/WebP/GIF files. $rel is the stored value ("@art/…" or an upload path). Cached per file version.
- `landing_hosts_fit(array $c): string` - "cutout" or "photo": how the Concierges picture is fitted into its card. */
- `landing_hero_state(): array` - What the hero looks like right now. The "collage" layout needs a clean page, so it is only used when no background picture, slider or video is active; with one active it falls back to the simple layout over that background.
- `blog_cover_url(array $post): string` - Cover picture for a blog post: its own cover, else built-in art that suits its category. Always returns a URL. */
- `landing_sections(): array` - Enabled sections in admin order, content decoded. */
- `landing_slides(): array`
- `landing_profiles(int $limit = 0): array` - Members shown on the landing page, honouring the admin's "which profiles" choice. */
- `landing_profile_groups_all(): array` - The groups the "New faces" section can show, with the default wording for each tab. */

- `location_image_url(array $p): string` - Picture URL for a town card: the admin's own image, else the built-in art for that kind of place. */
- `landing_location_tiles(array $c): array` - Tiles for the "locations" section. $c is the section's content: show = counties|towns|mixed, count, source = picked (places ticked "Show on landing page") | popular | busiest, only_members = hide places nobody has joined from yet.

- `landing_testimonials(int $limit = 6): array`
- `landing_faqs(int $limit = 5): array`
- `landing_blog(int $limit = 3): array`
- `hero_overlay_style(): string` - CSS custom properties for the hero overlay, from the admin's Hero & header settings. */
- `plan_highlights(array $plan, int $max = 5): array` - Highlights of a plan for the pricing teasers (plain language). */
- `lp_head(array $c, string $actions = ''): string` - Section heading block used by every landing section. $c is the section's decoded content. */
- `lp_button(string $text, string $url, string $class = 'btn btn-primary btn-lg'): string` - Link button from admin-entered text + url; opens the sign-up modal for /register links. */

## includes/lib/matching.php

- `matching_weights(): array` - The seven weights as fractions that add up to 1. */
- `matching_load(array $ids): array` - Everything the scorer needs about a set of members, keyed by user id. */
- `matching_context(int $userId): ?array` - What the member's own behaviour says about their taste: the interests and intents of profiles they liked, favourited or looked at for a while, plus their recent searches, plus who liked or passed on whom.
- `matching_clamp(float $v): float`
- `matching_pair(array $ctx, array $t): array` - Score one candidate for the member in $ctx (from matching_context()). $t is a row from matching_load(). Returns the seven components (0-100), the total (with bonuses) and flags.
- `matching_compat(array $c, array $w): float` - Fit score for display: the five components that describe how well two people suit each other. */
- `matching_store(int $userId, array $scored, string $at): void` - Write scored rows for one member in chunks. $scored: [targetId => components]. */
- `matching_recompute_user(int $userId): void` - Score the member's best candidates again and replace what was stored. */
- `matching_recompute_all(int $limit = 500): int` - Refresh every member's scores, oldest first. Returns how many members were refreshed. */
- `matching_ensure_fresh(int $userId): void` - Make sure the member has recent scores: none yet, older than the admin's refresh time, or new members have joined since the last run (checked at most every ten minutes).
- `matching_scores(int $userId, array $targetIds): array` - Scores for specific candidates: [targetId => ['total','compat','interest',...]]. Pairs with no stored score (new members, people outside the stored set) are scored on the spot and kept.

Pictures are re-encoded (EXIF stripped); PNGs keep transparency only when they have some; SVG logos are sanitised; MP4/WebM videos are accepted for the hero. @return array ['ok'=>bool,'error'=>string,'item'=>array|null]
- `media_delete(int $id): array` - Delete a library file, but only when nothing on the site uses it. @return array ['ok'=>bool,'error'=>string] */

## includes/lib/members.php

Filters (all optional): gender male|female|non-binary|other|array (who to show) age_min, age_max ints distance_km int (needs the viewer's location) county_id, location_id limit to a county / town (location_id may be a county or a town id) county_slug limit to a county or town by slug verified true = verified only online true = active in the last online_window_minutes active_days int active within N days has_photo true (default) = must have an approved primary photo has_bio true height_min, height_max, education (LIKE), body_type intent string interest_ids array of interest ids (must share at least one) exclude_ids array of user ids to leave out only_ids array of user ids to restrict to role user (default) | host | any q name search hide_swiped true = skip people the viewer already liked/passed order smart (default) | newest | active | distance | random | featured | score seed string seed for stable random ordering @return array ['rows' => normalised member rows, 'total' => int]
- `member_normalize(array $r): array` - Turn a raw query row into display-ready data, honouring the member's privacy flags. */
- `members_interests(array $userIds, int $perMember = 6): array` - Interests for a batch of members: [userId => [ ['id','name','emoji'], … ]] */
- `site_stats(): array` - Counts used by the landing page and auth pages. Cached for 10 minutes. */

## includes/lib/messaging.php

- `conversation_get_or_create(int $a, int $b, ?int $initiatedBy = null): int` - Find or create the single conversation between two members and return its id. */
- `conversation_load(int $convId, int $userId): ?array` - A conversation as seen by one participant, or null when they are not part of it. */
- `messaging_unread_total(int $userId): int` - Total unread messages for a member (the header badge). */
- `messaging_peer(int $otherId): ?array` - The other person in a conversation, ready for display. Null when the account no longer exists. */
- `conversation_set_flag(array $conv, string $flag, bool $on): void` - Pin, archive or mute a conversation for one participant. */
- `messaging_mask_text(string $text): array` - Hide phone numbers, e-mail addresses and chat/social handles in a piece of text. Pure function. Returns [maskedText, changed].
- `messaging_pair_has_booking(int $a, int $b): bool` - Did these two members have a booking that unlocks contact details? */
- `message_context(array $conv, int $viewerId): array` - Build the context used to render messages for one viewer in one conversation (counts and permissions are looked up once, not per message).
- `messaging_masking_applies(array &$ctx, int $senderId): bool` - Should contact details in a message from $senderId be hidden from the viewer? Fills the lazy counters in $ctx. */
- `messaging_display_text(string $text, array &$ctx, int $senderId): array` - Apply the viewer's contact and banned-word rules to a piece of text. Returns [text, wasMasked]. */
- `messaging_receipts_visible(int $viewerId, int $otherId): bool` - May $viewerId see whether $otherId has read their messages? */
- `messaging_image_size(?string $rel): array` - Width and height of a stored chat image, so the page can reserve space before it loads. */
- `message_system_payload(?string $content): ?array` - Decode the JSON payload of a system message (gift notices, etc.). Plain text returns null. */
- `message_format(array $m, array &$ctx): array` - One message as the browser receives it. The original text of a masked message never leaves the server. */
- `messages_fetch(int $convId, int $limit = MSG_PAGE_SIZE, int $beforeId = 0, int $afterId = 0): array` - Messages of a conversation, oldest first. $beforeId pages backwards; $afterId polls forwards. */
- `conversation_mark_read(array $conv): int` - Mark everything the other person sent as read and clear this member's unread counter. */
- `messaging_read_upto(array $conv, array $ctx): int` - Highest id among the viewer's own messages that the other person has read (0 when none or receipts are hidden). */
- `messaging_set_typing(int $convId, int $userId): void`
- `messaging_clear_typing(int $convId, int $userId): void`
- `messaging_other_typing(int $convId, int $otherId): bool`
- `messaging_protect_media_dir(): void` - Chat photos are private: the web server must not hand them out by address. They are read through GET /messages/media/{id}, which checks that the viewer is one of the two people in the conversation. (Apache honours this file; the development router refuses the folder too.)
- `messaging_images_allowed(): array` - May the current member attach photos? Returns [bool, reason]. */
- `messaging_clean_text(string $text): string` - Trim a typed message, drop control characters and tame blank lines. */
- `message_send(int $convId, string $text, ?array $imageFile = null): array` - Send a message as the signed-in member. Handles access, limits, banned words, images, unread counters and the recipient notification. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'error'=>string, 'code'=>string, 'status'=>int, 'message'=>array, 'remaining'=>int, 'notice'=>string]
- `messaging_notification_preview(string $text): string` - Notification and e-mail preview text: contact details are always hidden here. */
- `message_post_system(int $convId, int $actorId, array $payload): int` - Add a system line to a conversation (gift notices, etc.). $payload is stored as JSON. The unread counter goes up for the member who did not trigger it.
- `message_delete_own(int $messageId): array` - Delete one of your own messages (soft delete: the row stays for moderation until retention removes it). */
- `message_can_edit(array $m, int $viewerId): bool` - Can the member still edit this message (own, plain text, not deleted, inside the time window the admin allows)? */
- `message_edit_own(int $messageId, string $text): array` - Edit one of your own messages. The new text goes through the same length and banned-word rules as a new message. */
- `messaging_time_label(?string $dt): string` - "14:05", "Yesterday", "Tue", "12 Oct" for conversation lists. */
- `messaging_inbox(int $userId, string $view = 'active', int $limit = 80, int $includeId = 0): array` - Conversation list for a member. $view is 'active' or 'archived'. A just-opened empty conversation ($includeId) is always included so it appears while you write the first message.
- `messaging_inbox_signature(array $items): string` - A short fingerprint of the inbox so the browser can skip re-rendering when nothing changed. */
- `messaging_icebreakers(): array` - Random conversation starters from the admin's list. */
- `messaging_thread_data(array $conv, array $peer, array $viewer): array` - What the browser needs to draw and run one thread. Everything here is already filtered for the viewer. */
- `messaging_peer_payload(array $peer): array` - The peer fields the browser needs (the photo goes through the privacy-aware URL helper). */
- `messaging_purge_old(): int` - Delete messages older than msg_retention_days (and their photos). Called from the daily cron job. Returns the number removed. */

- `mpesa_c2b_shortcode(): string`
- `mpesa_c2b_ready(): bool`
- `mpesa_c2b_register(): array` - Tell Safaricom where to send C2B notifications. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'message'=>string] */
- `mpesa_c2b_simulate(float $amount, string $reference): array` - Sandbox only: ask Safaricom to simulate a customer paying to the short code. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'message'=>string] */

- `mpesa_b2c_ready(): bool`
- `mpesa_b2c_for(string $kind, int $refId): ?array` - The latest B2C request for a payout, or null. */
- `mpesa_b2c_send_payout(string $kind, int $id, ?int $adminId): array` - Send a Host payout or a gift-wallet payout through M-Pesa. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'error'=>string, 'message'=>string] */
- `mpesa_b2c_send_test(string $phone, float $amount, ?int $adminId): array` - Send a small test payout (admin setup page). @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'error'=>string, 'message'=>string] */
- `mpesa_b2c_dispatch(int $reqId): array` - Call Safaricom for a queued request. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'error'=>string, 'message'=>string] */
- `mpesa_b2c_parse_result(array $payload): ?array` - Parse the Result Safaricom posts after a B2C request. @return array|null keys: originator, conversation, code, desc, receipt, amount, receiver
- `mpesa_b2c_settle(array $req, string $receipt): void` - The money left: mark the payout paid and tell the member. */
- `mpesa_b2c_handle_result(array $payload, string $urlSecret, string $ip): array` - Safaricom reports the result of a B2C payment. Always answers Accepted. */
- `mpesa_b2c_handle_timeout(array $payload, string $urlSecret, string $ip): array` - Safaricom could not deliver the request in time. The outcome is unknown, so it stays blocked until an admin checks. */
- `mpesa_b2c_release(int $reqId): array` - Admin: after checking the M-Pesa portal, free a stuck request so the payout can be sent again. */
- `mpesa_b2c_cron(): array` - Cron: send small payout requests automatically when the admin switched that on. */

- `mpesa_build_query_request(string $checkoutId, array $cfg, ?string $timestamp = null): array` - The body of an STK query request. */

- `mpesa_result_message(int $code, string $desc = ''): string` - Plain-language text for an M-Pesa result code. */
- `mpesa_error_message(?array $j, int $status): string` - Map a Daraja error response to a sentence for the member. */

- `mpesa_stk_query(array $payment): array` - Ask Safaricom what happened to an STK push. state: paid | failed | pending | unknown. @return array ['state'=>string, 'code'=>int, 'message'=>string]
- `mpesa_parse_query_response(int $status, string $body): array` - Read an STK query response. A 500 "transaction is being processed" answer means still pending. */

- `mpesa_apply_result(array $payment, array $res): string` - Apply an M-Pesa result (from the callback or from an STK query) to a payment. Safe to repeat. Returns: completed | failed | cancelled | mismatch | duplicate | ignored.
- `mpesa_ip_allowed(string $ip, array $allowed): bool` - Is $ip inside one of the allowed addresses or CIDR ranges? */
- `mpesa_handle_callback(array $payload, string $urlSecret, string $ip): array` - Handle a request to the M-Pesa callback address. Returns [httpStatus, responseBody]. $urlSecret is the secret part of the address ('' for the plain address).
- `payments_mpesa_initiate(array $payment, string $rawPhone): array` - Start an STK push for a pending payment. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'error'=>string, 'message'=>string, 'wait'=>int]
- `payments_mpesa_reconcile(array $payment): array` - Re-check a waiting STK push with Safaricom (at most every 8 seconds) in case the callback has not arrived. Returns the fresh payment row.
- `payments_submit_manual(array $payment, string $kind, string $code, string $phone, string $paidOn): array` - A member says they paid by hand. The payment stays pending until an admin approves or rejects it (payment_complete() / payment_fail()). @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'error'=>string]
- `payments_test_finish(array $payment, bool $success): array` - Test mode only: finish a payment without any money moving. */
- `payments_cancel(array $payment): bool` - Member cancels an unpaid payment. */
- `payments_stk_seconds_left(array $payment): int` - Seconds left of the phone-prompt wait for an STK push that was sent (0 when none is waiting). */
- `payments_perform_action(array $payment, string $action, array $in): array` - Run one action on the member's own payment: mpesa | manual | bank | test | cancel | retry. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'error'=>string, 'message'=>string, 'wait'=>int, 'redirect'=>string, 'payment_id'=>int, 'state'=>string]

## includes/lib/payments_online.php

- `pay_log(string $message, array $ctx = []): void`
- `pg_site_currency(): string`
- `pg_zero_decimal(string $currency): bool` - Currencies the gateways count without cents. */

- `pg_complete(array $payment, string $gateway, string $txnId, string $method = ''): string` - Finish a payment that a gateway says is paid. The payment may already have been cancelled or timed out on our side; a success that arrives late still means the money moved, so it is honoured once (fulfilment runs a single time). Returns completed | duplicate.

- `pg_return_url(string $gateway): string` - Where the gateway sends the member back. */

- `pay_saved_get(int $uid, int $id): ?array`

- `pay_saved_remove(int $uid, int $id): bool`
- `pay_saved_label(array $s): string`
- `pg_remember_card(array $payment, string $gateway, string $token, string $fingerprint, array $info): void` - Save the card a payment was made with, when the member asked for automatic renewal. Records its id on the payment. */
- `paystack_ready(): bool`
- `paystack_call(string $method, string $path, ?array $json = null): array` - @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'status'=>int, 'data'=>array, 'message'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `paystack_start(array $payment, string $storedMethod = 'paystack', array $channels = []): array` - Start a Paystack checkout. $channels limits it (for example ['card']). @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'url'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `paystack_order_ref(string $ref): string` - The order reference inside a Paystack reference ("CH261016ABC123-X7Y8Z9" -> "CH261016ABC123"). */
- `paystack_apply(array $payment, array $tx): string` - Apply a Paystack transaction (from verify, the webhook or a saved-card charge) to its payment. Safe to repeat. Returns completed | duplicate | mismatch | failed | pending.
- `paystack_verify(array $payment): array` - Ask Paystack about the payment's latest attempt. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'outcome'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `paystack_charge_saved(array $payment, array $saved): array` - Charge a saved card without the member being present (automatic renewal). @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'outcome'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `paystack_handle_webhook(string $raw, string $signature): array` - The signed webhook. Returns [httpStatus, body]. */
- `paypal_config(): array`
- `paypal_ready(): bool`
- `paypal_amount(float $siteAmount): array` - What PayPal charges for an order. PayPal does not accept every currency (not Kenyan shillings), so the price is converted at the rate the admin set. */
- `paypal_token(): array` - @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'token'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `paypal_call(string $method, string $path, ?string $jsonBody = null, array $headers = []): array` - @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'status'=>int, 'data'=>array, 'error'=>string] */
- `paypal_start(array $payment): array` - Create a PayPal order and return where to send the member. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'url'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `paypal_apply_capture(array $payment, array $capture): string` - Apply a PayPal capture to its payment. $capture is one entry of purchase_units[0].payments.captures. Returns completed | duplicate | mismatch | failed | pending.
- `paypal_capture(array $payment): array` - The member came back from PayPal: capture the approved order. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'outcome'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `paypal_check_order(array $payment): array` - Check a pending PayPal order without capturing (used by the reconcile job). */
- `paypal_handle_webhook(string $raw, array $headers): array` - PayPal webhook: the signature is checked by PayPal itself. Returns [httpStatus, body]. */
- `stripe_ready(): bool`
- `card_ready(): bool` - Is the card option usable, through whichever gateway the admin chose? */
- `stripe_call(string $method, string $path, array $form = []): array` - @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'status'=>int, 'data'=>array, 'error'=>string] */
- `stripe_start(array $payment): array` - Start a Stripe Checkout session for a card payment. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'url'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `stripe_fetch_session(string $id): array` - Fetch a Checkout session with the card details expanded. */
- `stripe_apply_session(array $payment, array $session): string` - Apply a Checkout session to its payment. Returns completed | duplicate | mismatch | pending | failed. */
- `stripe_verify(array $payment): array` - The member came back from Stripe, or the job is checking a waiting payment. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'outcome'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `stripe_charge_saved(array $payment, array $saved): array` - Charge a saved card off-session (automatic renewal). @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'outcome'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `stripe_signature_ok(string $raw, string $header, string $secret, int $tolerance = 300, ?int $now = null): bool` - Check the Stripe-Signature header (t=timestamp,v1=hmac). */
- `stripe_handle_webhook(string $raw, string $sigHeader): array`
- `payments_online_start(array $payment, string $method): array` - Start a hosted checkout. $method: paystack | paypal | card. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'url'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `payments_online_verify(array $payment): array` - Check a waiting hosted payment with its gateway. @return array ['ok'=>bool, 'outcome'=>string, 'error'=>string] */
- `payments_online_housekeeping(): array` - Cron: re-check payments that were sent to a gateway but never reported back (a closed tab, a missed webhook), and close ones nobody finished after three days. Returns counts.
